items.rationale: The swerve-induced impact is covered under §§2.6.2–2.6.3 and 4.5. Under §§7.1.7 and 7.1.10, I estimate €950 gross for the equivalent display assembly and fitting; together with the housing repair, that is €1,300, below the roughly €1,400 purchase-price benchmark.

Section 2.6.3(b) covers the impact damage to the housing even if the laptop still operates. I estimate €350 gross for the equivalent shell and fitting under §§7.1.7 and 7.1.10, with no separate deductible for this second damage area.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.11 exclude cosmetic work on the old scuff because the impact did not cause it. The threshold is zero; €25 is a conditional price estimate only.

Section 5.2.3 expressly covers the necessary examination of equipment damaged in an insured event. An ordinary €65 gross bench diagnostic is below the €250 event cap and is payable only to the extent it was not credited against the repair.
